desc: As part of Bond Arm's efforts to honor the First Family in the White House, Bond Arms brings you The First Lady. This nod to the country's leadership is beautifully caught in this stunning heirloom. However, beauty is not the only great part about this firearm. Form meets function as The First Lady is chambered in the powerful, yet manageable, .38 Special. Additionally, The First Lady sports Bond Arm's extended B6 grips for comfort and manageability. Be part of the legacy, but don't wait too long. This piece of art will be manufactured in limited quantities.
